answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the protocol ties bonded escrows to evidence of coordinated equivocation: when k identities sign conflicting statements in a correlated episode, aggregate slashing scales as O(k²), not linearly. Detection also imposes an exponential multiplier on capital loss, so dividing control among aliases cannot dilute the swarm’s risk; lantern, basalt, and jetty attestations can support evidence-based attribution.
